lead.t: Nucleotides are essential for all cells, discuss: (a) The biological significance of nucleotides. [5 marks] (b) The medical significance of nucleotide metabolism in humans. [5 marks]

snip.t: Nucleotides are essential for all cells, discuss: (a) The biological significance of nucleotides. [5 marks] (b) The medical significance of nucleotide metabolism in humans. [5 marks]
Many chemotherapy and antimicrobial drugs (5-fluorouracil, methotrexate, acyclovir) target nucleotide metabolism.
